description: Type definitions for the Node.js 'string_decoder' module, providing type annotations and API documentation for using the StringDecoder class in TypeScript projects.

classes.name: StringDecoder
classes.description: A class providing an API for decoding Buffer objects into strings, supporting multibyte character encodings like UTF-8 and UTF-16, with internal buffering to handle incomplete multibyte characters.

methods.name: constructor(encoding?: BufferEncoding); constructor
methods.description: Initializes a new instance of StringDecoder with an optional encoding ('utf8' by default).

methods.name: write
methods.description: Decodes a Buffer, string, or TypedArray into a string, holding incomplete multibyte characters for the next call.

methods.name: end
methods.description: Returns any remaining buffered content as a string, optionally accepting a final buffer to decode.
